phase2.baselineSource: git HEAD fa3ed0352d13fe3c26a24978f30453a899d11c7d plus original Nov4 npm inventory above
phase2.metadataCaveat: Package/meta counts vary with npm advisory ancestry recalculation. The Nov4-to-Nov5 64-to35 change with identical lock and identical9 GHSA IDs is not a local remediation. Final navigation changes9 to7 unique IDs; baseline102 to7 resolves95.
phase2.compatibility: Native/framework/direct navigation packages unchanged. Transitive parents remain semver satisfied except the explicit scoped ERPGulf Zod4.6.6 override of their exact4.1.5 pins; CLI Zod3 retained. No audit fix/force, native major, new root package, or lifecycle script execution.

validation.fullSuiteAndNativeExports: See validation.md for primary agent final integrated results

axios-node.exposure: Node HTTP/HTTP2/proxy adapter only; not the native XHR request path
axios-node.reachableVulnerablePrimitive: not reached by current React Native transport
evidence: services/api/apiClient.js creates explicit-method axios instances
node_modules/axios/package.json browser/react-native mappings exclude the Node HTTP adapter
services/api/mobileAuth.service.js uses separate expo/fetch transport
axios-node.safestFix: Axios 1.20.0 plus its compatible required Node dependencies; installed and tested. No app endpoint or retry contract changed.

axios-core.reachableVulnerablePrimitive: code can be loaded, but advisory trigger is not established; pollution gadgets require a separate prototype-pollution source
evidence: services/api/apiClient.js creates instances, explicitly sets methods through get/post/put and preserves method on retries
No app mutation of Object.prototype or caller-supplied Axios config object was found at these boundaries
axios-core.safestFix: Axios 1.20.0; installed. Preserve tenant-destination, refresh-generation and persistence behavior via API/auth regressions.

axios-browser.reachableVulnerablePrimitive: not the React Native standard-browser environment
evidence: node_modules/axios/lib/platform/common/utils.js excludes navigator.product ReactNative from hasStandardBrowserEnv
App native services use bearer credentials rather than browser cookie/XSRF authentication
axios-browser.safestFix: Axios 1.20.0; installed. Reevaluate if adding a browser target or cookie authentication.

axios-fetch.reachableVulnerablePrimitive: app does not select this adapter; native Axios defaults select available XHR first
evidence: node_modules/axios/lib/defaults/index.js adapter order
services/api/apiClient.js config does not opt into fetch adapter
Authentication SDK fetch and attachment global fetch are separate transports, not this Axios adapter
axios-fetch.safestFix: Axios 1.20.0; installed. Do not infer all fetch usages call Axios fetch adapter.

axios-form.exposure: Runtime conversion helpers for nested forms/JSON
axios-form.reachableVulnerablePrimitive: untrusted arbitrary-depth object/HTML-form conversion is not an established app call path
evidence: services/api/auth.service.js and apiClient refresh use app-owned URLSearchParams forms
Domain mutations build known-field payloads/FormData; app does not call axios.formToJSON on arbitrary DOM forms
axios-form.safestFix: Axios 1.20.0; installed; existing multipart/API/auth tests retained.

sdk-zod.exposure: Runtime validation in the two ERPGulf SDKs; separate Zod3 copy is Expo CLI tooling
sdk-zod.reachableVulnerablePrimitive: SDK schemas use fixed object/scalar/enum shapes, not array/record/map/set collection validators; CLI has array schemas for local devtool plugin metadata
evidence: node_modules/@erpgulf/auth-sdk/dist/index.js response schemas
node_modules/@erpgulf/server-lookup/dist/index.js lookup response schema and 16384-character token bound
node_modules/expo/node_modules/@expo/cli/build/src/start/server/DevToolsPlugin.schema.js
sdk-zod.safestFix: Scoped ERPGulf Zod4.6.6 overrides installed and real SDK/lookup contracts tested. Keep Expo CLI Zod3.25.76 until a supported parent update/backport; do not force a major validator into CLI.

navigation-decode.exposure: Runtime navigation URL/query parsing library; external linking is not configured in current navigator
navigation-decode.reachableVulnerablePrimitive: not reached by current external navigation flow; prior library could be called by future link parsing
evidence: navigation/navigator.jsx NavigationContainer has no linking configuration
services/notifications/fcm.service.js passes route names/params to navigateSafely, not getStateFromPath
@react-navigation/core7.22.1 src/queryString.ts replaces recursive decode dependency with bounded UTF8 matching
navigation-decode.safestFix: Compatible parent core7.22.1/routers7.6.5 installed; removes query-string/decode-uri-component instead of forcing an ESM-only decoder beneath a CJS caller.

firebase-node.exposure: Transitive Firebase JavaScript Node database/Firestore transport; app uses native RNFirebase app/messaging/crashlytics
firebase-node.reachableVulnerablePrimitive: not imported by the current native app services; no app gRPC server, certificate-auth handler or JS database connection
evidence: services/notifications/fcm.service.js native RNFirebase messaging imports
services/crashlytics.service.js lazy native RNFirebase crashlytics import
node_modules/@react-native-firebase/app/dist/module/internal/web/firebaseDatabase.js and firebaseFirestore.js separate web shims
firebase-node.safestFix: Compatible websocket-driver0.7.5, protobufjs7.6.6 and grpc1.9.16 installed. Remaining grpc server advisories need >=1.13.6, outside Firestore ~1.9.0; use supported Firebase parent coordination rather than a risky override.

devtools.exposure: React Native development tools/Metro WebSocket or shell tooling
devtools.reachableVulnerablePrimitive: development tooling path, not an established employee release request path

react-devtools-core dependency metadata identifies shell-quote and ws
No app shell-quote API or Node ws server import

lodash-runtime.exposure: Runtime Formik uses selected Lodash helpers; Jest also depends on Lodash

deepmerge-tool.exposure: Affected deepmerge4.3.1 used in Expo/Jest configuration; Formik resolves its separate2.2.1 instance outside the advisory range

evidence: node_modules/@expo/config/package.json deepmerge^4.3.1
node_modules/jest-config/package.json deepmerge^4.2.2
node_modules/formik/node_modules/deepmerge/package.json2.2.1
deepmerge-tool.safestFix: No patched4.x published in checked registry. Keep build/config input trusted and obtain an upstream backport or approved parent migration; do not rewrite Formik or force a major package.

uuid-xcode.reachableVulnerablePrimitive: specific v3/v5/v6 custom-buffer path not used; xcode invokes uuid.v4() without caller buffer
evidence: node_modules/xcode/lib/pbxProject.js:90 uuid.v4()
Package ancestry via Expo config-plugins; no app uuid import
uuid-xcode.safestFix: Need uuid>=11.1.1 through a supported Xcode tooling parent; current xcode^7.0.3 pin cannot accept this major. No automatic override.

glob-tool.reachableVulnerablePrimitive: AbortSignal/path traversal availability condition needs untrusted filesystem patterns/workload; not mobile attendance execution
evidence: Expo config/fingerprint/update scripts and Jest use Node glob
App does not import glob or expose a filesystem glob endpoint
glob-tool.safestFix: Current13.x remains affected; fix>=14.0.2 requires major/API change through supported Expo/tool parents. Keep build inputs trusted; no global major override.

minimatch-tool.exposure: Build/test globs and ESLint file patterns
minimatch-tool.reachableVulnerablePrimitive: attacker-controlled glob amplification not established; repository patterns are build/test inputs
evidence: Metro/Expo config, Jest and ESLint dependency paths
No application-facing minimatch/glob pattern API
minimatch-tool.safestFix: Compatible3.1.5/10.2.6 patch earlier ReDoS issues; residual globparts amplification needs>=11.0.1, outside parent majors. Obtain maintained backports or approved toolchain migration.

build-tool.reachableVulnerablePrimitive: not an app native request path; malformed build/config/test/plugin input is the relevant boundary
evidence: See concrete dependencyPaths in this inventory
No app source import of the affected Node helper
build-tool.safestFix: Compatible same-parent-semver patches installed where available; inherited entries remain only where an underlying major/no-patch issue persists.

runtime-meta-tool.exposure: Package has runtime use, but this npm meta-vulnerability is inherited from build/test tooling
runtime-meta-tool.reachableVulnerablePrimitive: no own advisory in the baseline entry; follow inherited vulnerable descendants instead of treating the framework as an exploit
evidence: Baseline entry advisories list is empty
React Native Jest preset and Expo config/CLI dependencies account for inherited entries
runtime-meta-tool.safestFix: Keep native/framework versions unchanged. Patch compatible descendants; remaining toolchain major migrations require approval.

withdrawn-meta.exposure: Original npm meta-vulnerability entry no longer reported by the refreshed registry
withdrawn-meta.reachableVulnerablePrimitive: no original package-specific advisory; no security patch to this native module was inferred
evidence: @react-native-community/datetimepicker9.1.0 unchanged
Nov5 current audit omits the baseline meta-entry
withdrawn-meta.safestFix: Do not claim a local fix from scanner metadata changes. Continue native compatibility checks separately.

advisoryTriage.closureCriterion: Native app has no glob traversal endpoint. Close with upstream13.x backport or approved toolchain accepting glob>=14.0.2; verify cancellation on local fixtures.

advisoryTriage.appSpecificEvidence: App uses axios.create instances and explicit method aliases; retries retain their own method. Advisory default-instance inherited-method PoC is not the current call path.

advisoryTriage.closureCriterion: This is a gRPC server handler-error disclosure; app starts no gRPC server. Close through supported Firebase/grpc parent update; do not force >=1.13.6 past Firestore ~1.9.0.
Build/test patterns are locally controlled. Close with maintained3.x/10.x backport or approved parents accepting minimatch>=11.0.1; do not blanket override majors.
Affected4.3.1 is build/config tooling; Formik resolves2.2.1 outside range. No fixed4.x available; close with upstream backport/supported parent replacement and malicious-config regression.

Server-side getAuthContext authentication with requireClientCertificate=false is not used by this native app. Close with supported Firebase parent accepting grpc>=1.13.6, or document continued exclusion of a Node server/web Firestore target.

advisoryTriage.classification: external dependency requiring Expo CLI ownership
advisoryTriage.closureCriterion: Runtime ERPGulf validators now use patched4.6.6; only CLI3.25.76 remains. Close with CLI-supported patched major/backport and constrained devtool-descriptor validation; never force Zod4 beneath CLI3.
xcode uses uuid.v4() without buffer, not vulnerable v3/v5/v6 custom-buffer functions. Close with parent supporting uuid>=11.1.1 and project-generation tests.
